{{Quote|The Empire maintains order, and people like you disrupt that order.|Sarkli to Wedge Antilles over Geonosis|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
'''Sarkli''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A member of the elite [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], Sarkli was the nephew of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] and one of the Empire's best [[Spy/Legends|spies]], even finding audience with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Prior to his involvement in the Empire, Sarkli was an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], flying under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. Sarkli was among the Rebel force that assisted in the [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuation of]] [[Great Temple/Legends|the Alliance's Yavin 4 base]], and later assisted in the operation to [[Mission to Dantooine|extract]] Imperial defector [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] from the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Sarkli, who was known for his big ego, eventually defected to the Empire during a rebel [[Defense of Ralltiir|defense of]] the planet [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].

During his time with the Empire, Sarkli disrupted Rebel plans to free Alliance prisoners of war from a facility orbiting the planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], eventually being tracked to the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] by the Rebel starfighter unit [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. He managed to survive this encounter, and was later assigned to the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]], where he guarded the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield bunker]] protecting the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]]. Sarkli would ultimately be [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] of the Rebel Alliance, who infiltrated the bunker with a team of Rebel operatives.

==Biography==
===Life under the Rebellion===
{{Quote|What do you mean 'stay behind?' You're gonna need my help to get out of there in one piece.|Sarkli voicing his disapproval of Luke Skywalker's orders on Dantooine|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
Sarkli, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was born prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] as the nephew of [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] under [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] governing body, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWCCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Sarkli}}</ref> Sarkli was eventually pit against his uncle's side during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] when he was recruited by the freedom-fighting movement known as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a starfighter pilot sometime around the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" />
[[File:SarkliVsWalkers.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Sarkli attacking Imperial walkers on Yavin.]]
During one of the routine [[Evacuation of Yavin|raids]] on the Alliance's base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] conducted by Imperial forces, Sarkli accompanied pilots [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] with the mission of defending the Rebel [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Luminous/Legends|''Luminous'']]. After the rebel transport successfully took off, the trio were notified that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] were trapped inside the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], as the rebel base was under siege by Imperial ground forces. Luke and Wedge decided to land near the entrance and rescue the two officers. Although Sarkli wanted to join them, thinking they wouldn't make it, Luke convinced him to provide aerial defense to which Sarkli reluctantly agree. After battling a number of stormtroopers Luke and Wedge managed to extract Dodonna and Derlin from the base but upon reaching the hangar bay they found that the hangar was infested with more stormtroopers and near the exit were two [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|scout]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. Although they were in an extremely precarious position, Sarkli managed to eliminate the two walkers and the group escape Yavin 4. Dodonna however completely disregarded Sarkli's brave effort.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> Ultimately however, Dodonna returned to Yavin 4 and was captured by Imperial forces after blowing up The Great Temple.<ref name="Krytos">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

Sarkli later accompanied Red Squadron to a meeting with [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], a Rebel sympathizer from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] wishing to defect from the Empire. However, when Celchu's rendezvous point on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] was compromised by an elite divison of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial army]] known as the Imperial [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commando corps]], the meeting was quickly converted into a [[Mission to Dantooine|rescue operation]]. Commander Skywalker took it upon himself to infiltrate the makeshift Imperial camp to rescue Celchu, ordering Sarkli and the rest of the strike team to wait with the ships. During Skywalker's absence, the team was wiped out by a sudden Imperial ambush, leaving Sarkli the only survivor, who reported what was happening to Skywalker when he and Celchu were arriving back to the landing area. After they got off planet, Celchu revealed information about the storm commandos to Luke and Sarkli.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

===Defection to the Empire===
{{Quote|You walked us right into their arms!|Luke Skywalker reflecting on Sarkli's defection|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
Sarkli later took part in a Rebel operation to [[Defense of Ralltiir|save]] a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] holed up by a team of storm commandos in a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. At first Sarkli flew as Luke's wingman wiping out Imperial forces from the sky and three bridges were obliterated to stem the flow other Imperial reinforcements, after which Luke and Sarkli landed to aid the scientists. It was their objective to safely escort the scientists to a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|blockade runner]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> 
[[File:Sarklishooting.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Sarkli on Dantooine.]]
When they landed, Luke seized an Imperial AT-ST walker to fight against the storm commando units. However, he noticed Sarkli sprinting towards a storm commando [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]]. After questioning his action, Sarkli told him that he was disenchanted with the Rebellion, and the Empire was where somebody of his caliber belonged. He surrendered himself to the storm commandos and boarded an Imperial [[Armored personnel carrier/Legends|APC]], leaving Luke flabbergasted. Because of this Luke had to defend the scientists on his own, and despite retaliation from the enemy forces managed to safely get the scientists to the blockade runner, and they birskly left Ralltiir.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> Sarkli quickly made a name for himself in the Empire, becoming [[Captain/Legends|captain]]<ref name="TotC-Card" /> of a storm commando unit. Sarkli also became a renowned [[Spy/Legends|spy]], even finding personal favor with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="SWCCG" />

===Assignment to Rori===
{{Quote|We bloodied their noses this time, but I'm sure our paths will cross again.|Sarkli after the clash with Renegade Squadron.|<ref name="Dark Side" />}}
After he deserted the Rebel Alliance on Ralltiir, Sarkli joined the elite Imperial storm commando corps, who were some of the moest seasoned soldier in the Imperial army. He proved to be an excellent officer and military leader who was firecely loyal to the New Order and the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]], who was very impressed with Sarkli and once granted him an audience. Sarkli also became renowned as a very intrepid spy.<ref name="SWCCG" /> Around a [[1 ABY/Legends|year]] following the Battle of Yavin and the incident on Ralltiir, Sarkli had attained the rank of captain and was commadning a detachment of strom commandos on an Imperial base located in a remote region of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], the moon of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Dark Side" />
[[File:Caliber.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Sarkli's betrayal.]]
After a briefing held within the outpost, some of his soldiers spent some time maintaining and mending their equipment and running traning simulations, until suddenly an alarm sounded through the rpair facility. An Imperial lieutenant exclaimed that the outpost was under attack by Rebel forces. The soliders spearheaded by Sarkli briskly rushed to the roof of the outpost and saw an Alliance assault ship landing a few hundred meters away. A squad of rebel opreatives ran down the ship's landing ramp. Sarkli took out his [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] to see the rebels up close. Upon examining the group, he discovered that this was in fact the mercenary [[Col Serra]] and his personal group of soldiers known as [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade squadron]]. Knowing that Renegade Squadron were a force to be reckoned with, he advised his soldiers to get ready for a tough fight. He then grabbed his rifle as the strom commandos took up firing positions.<ref name="Dark Side" />

A skrimish ensued between the strom commandos and the renegades, though the Rebel swere overwhelmed by the heavily trained and lethal storm commandos, and were ultimately forced to retreat. Col Serra along with his squadmates rushed back towards the assault ship. Although one of the lieutenants suggested they go after them and take the rmainder of Renegade Squadron out of the equation, another soldier said that the strom commandos were in no such positions as their ships were stiill undergoing maintanence. Sarkli said that they had already dealt a significant blow to the Renegades, and was sure they would corss paths again.<ref name="Dark Side" />

Sometime after the encounter, Sarkli organized a briefing of his key personnel stating that although Imperial intel have discovered an outpost located on Rori. A [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] appeared on the briefing table showing a map of Rori and the mission target. Sarkli explained that their orders were to secure any information about other pitnetial Rebel cells located on the moon. He belived that with all the recent Rebel activity on the moon that there must be a bigger base hidden somewhere.<ref name="Dark Side" />
[[File:Rori.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Rori, the moon of Naboo.]]
That evening, an Imperial landing craft dropped off Sarkli and a detachment of storm commandos just outisde the Rebel outpost, and the soldiers stealthily made their way towards the underground facility. As the strom commandos advanced they noticed that there didn't seem to be any sentries or active secruity systems. As they enterd, the team [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] activated scanning gear at the intersection of four dark corridors, but reported no activity. Sarkli emphasized that they needed to scower every corner of the facility for intel even if it was abandoned. Though Sarkli and his soldiers were greeted with an unewlcome suprise.<ref name="Dark Side" />

A female voice was heard from the darkness, and the snap-hiss of a purple [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] illminated the face of a [[Twi'lek/Legends|twi'lek]] in brown jedi robes. Down each of the three corridors, another lightsaber activated. A brawl ensued between the Jedi and Sarkli's commandos. The combat was short-ranged and vicious, corridors illuminated by the flashed of blaster fire and the arcs of Jedi lightsabers. The jedi managed to severely injure much of the team, even cutting off a few soldier's limbs before escaping the desolate outpost. One of the commandos recognized the Jedi as [[Rachi Sitra]], saying that she was "a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|jedi knight]], they don't get much tougher than that.<ref name="Dark Side" />

Shortly after the skirmish on Rori, Imperial intelligence scowered the abandoned bunker for any information, and discovered that members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were secretly harboring rebel forces on Naboo. Sarkli and his commandos were sent to crack down on the rebel forces. Although one of the soldiers questioned whether the attack on a Royal Naboo station would cause political unrest on the planet, though Sarkli emphasized that if they were hiding rebels, they were also enemies in the eyes of the new order.<ref name="Dark Side" />

They traveled to the facility on a landspeeder, and when they were deployed they immediatly encountered some Sceurity Force scouts and a firefight ensued, though the storm commandos quickly defeated the scouts and continued towards the facility. They reached one of the side doors, and one of the soldiers place a demoltion charge to detonate and it eventually blew the doors open, and waiting behind the door were rebel troops who were quick to engage the Imperial forces. When one of the commandos thew a grenade into the facility, it wiped out the rebel attackers, and when the smoke cleared they saw a gray-haired barking orders to the rebel defenders. Sarkli and his men were astonished to see it was in fact [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], a former member of Rebel High Command.<ref name="Dark Side" />

While the rebels put up a good fight, they were no match for the elite storm commandos and Iblis and the defenders were forced to retreat. As the troops advanced, Sarkli ordered the team slicer to download any information he could find in the facility's consoles. He got to work, while the other storm commandos tended to their wounds and packed up their equipment. The slicer reported that the Rebels have been on the move for the past three weeks up until that point. Sarkli told him to recovere everything he possibly could, so they data could be analzyed at their HQ.<ref name="Dark Side" />

===Mission to Corellia===
Following the infiltration of the facility on Naboo, Sarkli and his storm commandos traveled to [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]], an Imperial stronghold on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], as according to the logs from the facility the Rebels had an outpost near Bela Vistal hidden in the dense woods. Sarkli was rather weary about this operation as he belived that this would be more challenging that anything the commandos faced on Rori, thinking they would encounter fortified walls and well-trained defenders and sentries.<ref name="Dark Side" />

An Incom gunship landed some distance away from the outpost, and waite until twilight before making their way into the forest. They soon came across a few rebel sentries guarding the area around the bunker, and they were quickly taken out by the commandos. One of the sharpshooters shot another Rebel, but when they reached the sentry's position they disovered she was still breathing and holding her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. She managed to warn her comrades of the incoming Imperial forces before she finally succumbed to her injuries.<ref name="Dark Side" />
[[File:Col_Serra.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Col Serra, leader of Renegade Squadron.]]
The blast doors of the bunker flung open and Rebel operatives marched out, one at a time. Among the commandos was the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] general [[Polo Se'lab]]. The forces clashed, and although Selab trained his troops well, the Rebels were forced to fall back. The storm commandos then entered the bunker, though they kept a watchful eye for any rebels inside. After they wre inside, Sarkli double-checked the loadouts for all of his men, while the slicers cut the power to the light, alarms and security cameras. One of the comm techs found a transmission on one of the computer's, and elaborated that it was a heavily encrypted message to another location on Corellia and that as of now they couldn't determine the recipent. As they stealthily moved through darkened corridors, clearing each room, they found workers hiding behind some of the furniture and apprehended them.<ref name="Dark Side" /> 

When they cleared the top floor and secured all the other compartments they made their way towards the basement level. They reached the corridor leading to the war room in the center of the facility, and shorted out the security panel enetring the room. As Sarkli and his troops entered they heard avoice from the darkness, punctuated by the snap-hiss of a lightsaber. The shadowy figure turned out to be Sarkli's old friend, and now bitter enemy - Luke Skywalker. Sarkli and his men attacked the jedi. Skywalker fought against the strom commandos, deflecting bolts and sawing off blasters. He exclaimed that the facility was abndoned and that the rebels have escaped. One of the troopers tried to eliminate him but he quickly cut a hole in a door nearby and rushed into the corridor.<ref name="Dark Side" />

As they raced to the doorway, the trooper saw a narrow ventilation shaft. Luke had already lept out of the top and evaded Imperial capture. Although Sarkli was annoyed that they had lost him, the trooper said that after the significant blow they dealt to the rebel outpost that this was a satisfying result for the storm commandos.<ref name="Dark Side" />

===Enter the ''Conqueror''===
After successfully wiping out the rebel forces on Rori and Bela Vistal, Sarkli and his men were assigned to defend a heavily protected Imperial weapons depot on Naboo. On one occasion they were guarding the entrance, when klaxons began to whale signalling an enemy attack. Sarkli barked orders at his men to face the enemy. It turned out that the attackers were in fact Col Serra and Renegade Squadron. A quarrel began between the two focres though for once, Serra and his boys had the upper hand, and Sarkli and his men were forced to escape into the wilderness.<ref name="Light Side">''{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

When the Renegades encircled the facility they found dozens of cartes filled with weapons and ammunition. They began to take inventory, examining each crate in turn. The only office in the building housed a small safe, which one of the slicers began to crack open. It was filled with datafiles inside plastic cartridges. As the slicer placed them into one of the compuetr consoles a hologram of a [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|star destroyer]] appeared. Although it seemed unassuming at first the rebels noticed an oddity when the projection began to rotate. A strange dish like weapon sat on the bow, dividing the hull.<ref name="Light Side" />

One of the comm tehcs further investigated the files and came to the startling conclusion that the weapon was in fact a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], much like the one used for the Death Star. As it turned out, Sarkli and his men were guarding the plans to a new Imperial superweapo known as the star destroyer [[Conqueror (Imperial-class)|''Conqueror'']], whose superlaser dish was developed on a resarch facility on Naboo. Eventually following a series of mission, Serra and his men managed to locate and destroy the ''Conqueror'' before it could pose any major threat to the galaxy.<ref name="Light Side" />

===Raids on Bakura and Geonosis===
{{Quote|You're just like Skywalker, without your men, you're nothing!|Sarkli attacking Wedge Antilles.|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
It is unclear for how long Sarkli was assigned to Rori, but following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] he and his men
interfered with a Rebel [[Raid at Bakura|rescue mission]] over the planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. Sarkli's old mate Wedge along with [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Hobbie Klivian]] and another wingmate were given the daunting task of disabling a number of [[Imperial Action transport|action transports]] that were transporting Rebel POWs from an orbital detainment facility, and ensuring three [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|rescue transports]] could rescue the prisoners and leave the system safely. However things quickly turned south when Hobbie's X-Wing was damaged and he was sent careening towards Bakura's surface, forcing Wedge to steal a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bomber]] and rescue his mate. However upon returning to space, he found that Sarkli, piloting an [[Imperial escort carrier (storm commando)|Imperial escort carrier]], destroyed a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|rescue transports]] before fleeing to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. After the assault, general [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] informed Antilles that intel had intercepted a signal from a ship they belived to be the same one he encountered at Bakura. Wedge was still unaware that the attacker was his former friend and comrade, and so he entered hyperspace.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />
[[File:SarkliIsVeryAngry.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Sarkli flying a Republic gunship through the canyons of Geonosis.]]
Wedge along with the rescue transports entered the [[Geonosis system/Legends|system]] and began flying through the planet's rings. However when three escort carriers entered the system, Wedge realized Sarkli lured the pursuing Alliance fleet into an [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|ambush]], and he immediatly blew up one of the transports. Wedge engaged in combat with Sarkli, who began transmitting threats to him through radio. It was then when the pilot realized who the attacker really was. Sarkli told Wedge how the Empire were the peackeepers, and that people like him and his allies disturbed the peace. Eventually Sarkli's escort carrier sustained critical damage during the fight, forcing him and his men to retreat to the planet's surface in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The escort carrier then exploded and fell to pieces. Wedge's stabilizer was also crippled and he crashlanded near a canyon.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

He and his droid assiatant, an [[Unidentified R5 unit (Wedge Antilles)|R5-series astromech]] exited the damaged X-Wing and saw the Imperial forces exiting their escape pods. However strangely, Wedge also saw relics of Geonosis' past lurking about, Several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|Seperatist battle droids]] still in working order and with weapons in their hands were sitting there. When they saw Wedge and his astro-droid, a malfunction occured in their system and they percieved Wedge as a threat. Along the way Wedge fought against the battle droids and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], while trying to keep his astro-droid safe and unhurt.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

He finally reached the end of the canyon when sounds of aggresive laser fire resonated through the air. He heard cackling laughter coming from his comlink, and saw that Sarkli had manned an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] and was trying to kill him. Using a single [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web blaster cannon]] stolen from a stormtrooper, Antilles damaged Sarkli's gunship, causing it to careen into one of the canyon walls. He then fled the planet using an old and deserted [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|jedi starfighter]] and regrouped with Madine, eventually defeating the remaining Imperial forces.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

In reality, this entire scheme had been devised to drive the rebels away from a secret project the engineers at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] were working on. Darth Vader had ordered Sarkli to distract the rebel fleet, but Wedge and General Madine ultimately found out that the Empire was patenting a [[Cloak/Legends|cloaked]] [[Unidentified Executor-class Star Dreadnought|super star destroyer]] and they would later exterminate any threat the ship posed after [[Fondor shipyard assault|attacking]] the shipyards and destroying the dreadnought's [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] which cause a chain reaction within the ship and it combusted and fell apart, and another great undertaking was thwarted by the Alliance.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

===Battle of Endor and death===
{{Quote|This is the end, Solo. You'll never leave this bunker alive!|Sarkli to Han Solo in the shield bunker|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
Sarkli managed to survive the incident, and continued serving the Empire.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> Around a [[4 ABY/Legends|year]]<ref name="Chronology". /> after the skirmish at Geonosis, Sarkli along with several other Imperial officers was stationed on the under-construction superweapon [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] over the forest moon of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. Around this time Sarkli was very close to getting a promotion.<ref name="SWCCG" /> He was one of the officers present when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] paid a visit to the station, where he met up with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Jerjerrod]], the station's commander.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Sarkli was also standing by when the Emperor arrived on the battlestation not long after.<ref name="ToppsCard">{{Topps|set=1983 Topps Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Series 1|cardname=On the Death Star|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/72969/cid/5256904/1983-Topps-Return-Of-The-Jedi-54-On-the-Death-Star}}</ref>
[[File:Sarkliandhan.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Sarkli's final moments.]]
Sarkli was later transported to the battlestation's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield bunker]] on the sanctuary moon. A few days after Vader's arrival, Skywalker and his mates from the Alliance had devised a plan to infiltrate the forest moon of Endor and wipe out the shield so the Alliance navy could destroy the station and liquidate the Emperor. They reached the moon using the stolen [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|Tydirium]] and managed to decieve the Imperials above the moon using an old clearance code. They landed on the surface, and after a skirmish with a few scout troopers and meeting and befriending the indigenous [[Ewok/Legends|ewok]] population of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], they found a secret pathway leading to the shield bunker's backdoor. After they infiltrated the bunker they cornered the officers present, but were quickly detained by lieutenant [[Renz/Legends|Renz]] and his troopers. When they exited the bunker, they found the area sorrounded by Imperial forces on all sides. However, after [[R2-D2/Legends|two]] [[C-3PO/Legends|droids]] on a small mound called for help, an Imperial officer ordered some sttromtroopers to bring the droids to the backdoor. However this turned out to be a ploy, and from the wilderness Ewok hunters began attacking the Imperials and chaos ensued.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Sarkli failed to prevent the [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from entering the bunker and planting explosives. In a last ditch effort, after most of the Imperials had been killed or captured, Sarkli entered the bunker and confronted Solo with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and attempted to block his escape from the exploding bunker. Solo told Sarkli that the Empire was finished, and that Sarkli chose the wrong path. Disregarding Solo's comments Sarkli began attacking him and chasing him through the bunker's hallways, taunting him. Sarkli ultimately received a fatal wound from Solo's blaster near the main entrance after a short skirmish, falling to Solo despite his skill with a blaster.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> Han and the rest of the scouts briskly sprinted out of the bunker as it exploded. The rebels used this to their advantage, and eventually a flight group led by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Sarkli's former friend and wingmate Wedge Antilles crippled the Death Star's main reactor and the station began falling apart, eventually bursting inot a fireball, taking the Emperor with it. The battle was ultimately a tremendous victory of the Rebellion, and the Empire's hierarchy was battered. Sarkli's uncle, Admiral Piett, died in the battle when [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]] careened his starfighter into the bridge of the flagship [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] which sent the massive dreadnought crashing into the battlestation's surface, bursting into flames.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:CaptainSarkli-SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|250px|Captain Sarkli as a Storm Commando]]
{{Quote|Get off your butts, men! We're under attack.|Sarkli|<ref name="TOTC">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Captain Sarkli}}</ref>}}
Sarkli had a large ego, one which would ultimately lead to his defection from the Rebellion. During his time under the Rebellion, although Luke and Wedge respected and liked him as a friend, his contributions were often thrown under the rug by officers like Doddonna and he was in Luke's shadow, who was sometimes credited with Sarkli's successes, with Dodonna even saying he owed his life to Skywalker despite Sarkli rescuing them from the walkers. He also often felt restrained by his commander's orders, and vocally expressed dismay at being ordered to stand down from battle on Dantooine. Moments before his ultimate defection to the Empire on Ralltiir, Sarkli claimed a person of his own skill was above the Rebellion.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

As an Imperial, Sarkli viewed the Empire as a peacekeeping entity, and the Rebellion as an inhibitor of that peace.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> His commitment to the Empire's cause, going as far as to having no qualms with killing his former allies, led him to become one of their most valuable assets, and he was considered a master spy.<ref name="SWCCG" /> He proved to be a ruthless and skilled commander within the Storm Commando corps who was highly praised by his troopers.<ref name="Dark Side" /> However, he was never able to best his former allies in the Rebel Alliance, ultimately meeting his end by challenging his former teammate Han Solo. He had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and black hair.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

==Skills and abilities==
During his time in the Rebellion Sarkli was a talented pilot and scout, and was known to be a good with a rifle.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> After joining the Empire he gained a reputation as a competent squad leader and counterintelligence officer.<ref name="Dark Side" /><ref name="SWCCG" /> 

==Equipment==
During his time in the rebellion, Sarkli piloted a typical T-65 X-wing starfighter manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]], and he carried an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. He sometimes donned a light grey jumpsuit with black gloves and a white and black armor plate.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> After joining the Storm Comando Corps he donned [[Storm Commando armor/Legends|their signature armor]] and carried a [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]].<ref name="TOTC" /> He would also occasionally wear the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sarkli's first appearance in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' films was in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] as a nameless Imperial officer played by an uncredited extra during the Death Star II hangar bay scenes.<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[2000]], the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] named Sarkli in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity and established him as a highly commendable spy and relative of Piett who found favor with Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="SWCCG" />

Sarkli was fleshed out in the [[LucasArts]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', voiced by [[Robin Atkin Downes]]. He initially appears as an ally and wingmate to the player in the missions "Revenge of the Empire," "Defiance on Dantooine," and "Defenders of Ralltiir" before becoming the game's primary antagonist. The first time the player fights him during the mission "Relics of Geonosis," Sarkli pilots a salvaged Republic gunship and is shot down by the player with an E-web cannon. He is fought a second and final time in the final mission of the Endor campaign, "Triumph of the Rebellion." The player, as Han Solo, engages in a firefight with Sarkli (who is donning storm commando armor) while escaping the burning bunker on Endor.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />
[[File:MoffJerjerrodGreetsVader.jpg|left|thumb|290px|A scene from the special edition version of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', reused from an alternative angle of Vader's arrival from ''Return of the Jedi''.]]
Images found on "T-bone's Star Wars Universe" website show that Sarkli was meant to appear in at least one more scene in ''Return of the Jedi''. The last two images show an extended version of the Emperor's arrival, with Sarkli visible on the penultimate photo.<ref name="T-bone">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarz.com/tbone/index.php?categoryid=11&p2_articleid=5|text="Off To See The Emperor"|work=[https://starwarz.com/tbone T-bone's Star Wars Universe]|archivedate=20061117202450}}</ref>

Stock footage of scenes from ''Return of the Jedi'' was later added into the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|special edition]] of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Although the extra playing Sarkli can be seen during Darth Vader's return to the ''Executor'',<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> that does not necessarily make Sarkli canonically appear in the film.

===Non-canon storyline===
{{Quote|Captain Sarkli.''"<br />"''My liege?''"<br />"''Take your troops and destroy the clone.|Emperor Palpatine and Captain Sarkli|<ref name="FUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
Sarkli is present during the non-canon exploits of fallen [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Galen Marek]]'s [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], the [[Dark Apprentice]], in the [[Infinities]] expansion of the LucasArts video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', voiced by [[Jarion Monroe]]. The Dark Apprentice is tasked with countering the Rebel attack on the shield generator on Endor to keep the second Death Star secure, killing the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]],<ref name="FUII" /> and Han Solo, the last being Sarkli's would-be killer.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> After the death of Organa, Emperor Palpatine orders Captain Sarkli to lead his men in a mission to destroy the Dark Apprentice. A fleet commanded by Sarkli is seen enclosing around the Dark Apprentice before the game cuts to black. Sarkli's name is misspelled as "Sarcli" in the mission's end credits.<ref name="FUII" />
